verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a bundle of editable prompt and skill files installed into a repo and run by third-party agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot. It operates no service that collects user data, so a training opt-out is a property of the underlying model provider rather than of this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence suggests the product handles user data or offers privacy controls that would make this axis apply.
